question: The 2025 Sheikh Zayed Book Award recognised which author as the Cultural Personality of the Year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haruki Murakami**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Haruki Murakami, the renowned Japanese author, was recognised as the **Cultural Personality of the Year** in 2025 by the Sheikh Zayed Book Award committee.
 
• The Sheikh Zayed Book Award is one of the most prestigious literary awards in the Arab world, aiming to celebrate intellectuals, writers, and publishers.
 
• Murakami is celebrated for his unique storytelling style, blending surrealism, magical realism, and deep human emotions in his works.
 
• Some of his famous works include **"Norwegian Wood," "Kafka on the Shore,"** and **"1Q84."**
 
• This recognition further cements Murakami's global influence and contribution to contemporary literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sheikh Zayed Book Award**

 
 
• Named after Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, this award honours contributions to Arabic culture, language, and literature.
 
• The award comprises nine categories, including Literature, Translation, and Cultural Personality of the Year.
 
• The Cultural Personality of the Year award recognises individuals or organisations for their significant contributions to Arab culture and thought.
 
• Winners receive a gold medal, a certificate of merit, and a monetary prize.
 
 
 
• **Haruki Murakami's Literary Style**
 
 
• Murakami's works often explore themes of loneliness, existentialism, and the human condition.
 
• His writing blends elements of Western and Japanese literary traditions.
 
• He is known for his deep character development and use of music and pop culture references in his storytelling.
 
 
 
• **Global Impact of Murakami**
 
 
• Murakami's novels have been translated into over 50 languages, making him one of Japan's most internationally acclaimed authors.
 
• He has received numerous awards, including the Franz Kafka Prize and the Jerusalem Prize.
 
• His works have significantly contributed to bridging cultural gaps between Japan and the global literary community.
 
 
 
• **Other Prestigious Literary Awards**
 
 
• The Nobel Prize in Literature: Awarded annually for outstanding contributions in literature.
 
• The Booker Prize: Recognizes the best novel written in English and published in the UK/Ireland.
 
• The Pulitzer Prize: Celebrates excellence in journalism, literature, and musical composition in the United States.
